entries.title: Rise to Ruins
entries.definitive_edition: Rise to Ruins on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Rise to Ruins is documented on Steam as a godlike village simulation, management, and tower-defense game released on October 14, 2019, with Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS support. No sourced console or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC is the main archive route for capture/settings control, while macOS and Linux are valid native desktop alternatives.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam for the main archive route. Use macOS or Linux only as native convenience alternatives.
